mapper.select: select c.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm from mst_cust c where c.cust_type in ('SALES', 'BOTH') and c.use_yn = 'Y' order by c.cust_cd
select c.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_type, c.use_yn from mst_cust c where c.cust_cd = #{custCd}
select i.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, i.use_yn from mst_item i where i.item_cd = #{itemCd}

select i.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, i.use_yn from mst_item i where i.use_yn = 'Y' and (i.item_cd like upper(#{q}) || '%' escape '\' or i.item_nm ilike '%' || #{q} || '%' escape '\') order by i.item_cd limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: o.order_id, o.order_no, o.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, o.cust_po_no, o.order_date, o.status, o.remark, (select count(*) from sal_order_line l where l.order_id = o.order_id) as line_cnt, (select count(*) from sal_order_line l where l.order_id = o.order_id and l.status = 'OPEN') as open_cnt, (select min(l.due_date) from sal_order_line l where l.order_id = o.order_id and l.status = 'OPEN') as next_due, o.row_ver, o.updated_at, o.updated_by
mapper.select:
select from sal_order o join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = o.cust_id
order by o.order_date desc, o.order_id desc limit #{limit}

select from sal_order o join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = o.cust_id
order by
o.order_no desc c.cust_cd desc next_due desc nulls last o.status desc o.order_date desc ,
o.order_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*) from sal_order o
select count(*) from sal_order o join sal_order_line l on l.order_id = o.order_id
select status from sal_order where order_id = #{id} for update
select order_id from sal_order where cust_id = #{custId} and cust_po_no = #{custPoNo}

insert into sal_order (comp_cd, order_no, cust_id, cust_po_no, order_date, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{orderNo}, #{f.custId}, #{f.custPoNo}, #{f.orderDate}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning order_id
mapper.update: update sal_order o set status = s.next_status, row_ver = o.row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} from (select case when bool_or(l.status = 'OPEN') then 'OPEN' when bool_and(l.status = 'CANCELLED') then 'CANCELLED' else 'CLOSED' end as next_status from sal_order_line l where l.order_id = #{id}) s where o.order_id = #{id} and o.status = 'OPEN' and s.next_status is not null and s.next_status <> o.status
mapper.sql: l.line_id, l.order_id, l.line_no, l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, trim_scale(l.qty)::text as qty, l.due_date, l.status, l.cancel_reason, l.remark, trim_scale(l.shipped_qty)::text as shipped_qty, l.done_by_ship_yn, l.row_ver, l.updated_at, l.updated_by
mapper.select: select from sal_order_line l join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where l.order_id = #{orderId} order by l.line_no
select coalesce((max(line_no) / 10 + 1) * 10, 10) from sal_order_line where order_id = #{orderId}

insert into sal_order_line (comp_cd, order_id, line_no, item_id, qty, due_date, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{orderId}, #{f.lineNo}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.qty}, #{f.dueDate}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning line_id
mapper.update: update sal_order_line set qty = #{f.qty}, due_date = #{f.dueDate}, remark = #{f.remark}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where line_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: select count(*) from sal_order_line where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'OPEN' and shipped_qty > 0
select count(*) from sal_order_line
mapper.sql: r.rev_id, r.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, r.rev_no, r.received_at, r.source, r.import_job_id, j.file_nm, r.remark, r.created_by, (select count(*) from sal_forecast_line f where f.rev_id = r.rev_id) as line_cnt, (select min(f.bucket_start) from sal_forecast_line f where f.rev_id = r.rev_id) as first_bucket, (select max(f.bucket_start) from sal_forecast_line f where f.rev_id = r.rev_id) as last_bucket
mapper.select: select from sal_forecast_rev r join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = r.cust_id left join sys_import_job j on j.job_id = r.import_job_id where r.cust_id = #{custId} order by r.rev_no desc

select from sal_forecast_rev r join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = r.cust_id left join sys_import_job j on j.job_id = r.import_job_id where r.cust_id = #{custId} order by
r.received_at r.rev_no
desc,
r.rev_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*) from sal_forecast_rev r where r.cust_id = #{custId}
select from sal_forecast_rev r join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = r.cust_id left join sys_import_job j on j.job_id = r.import_job_id where r.rev_id = #{id}
select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('sal_forecast_rev'), hashtext(#{custId}::text))::text
select coalesce(max(rev_no), 0) + 1 from sal_forecast_rev where cust_id = #{custId}

insert into sal_forecast_rev (comp_cd, cust_id, rev_no, source, import_job_id, remark, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{custId}, #{revNo}, #{source}, #{jobId}, #{remark}, #{by}) returning rev_id

(hb_current_comp(), #{revId}, #{l.itemId}, #{l.bucketType}, #{l.bucketStart}, #{l.qty}, #{l.firmYn})
mapper.select: select f.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, f.bucket_type, f.bucket_start, trim_scale(f.qty)::text as qty, f.firm_yn from sal_forecast_line f join mst_item i on i.item_id = f.item_id where f.rev_id = #{revId} order by i.item_cd, f.bucket_type, f.bucket_start

select coalesce(a.item_id, b.item_id) as item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, coalesce(a.bucket_type, b.bucket_type) as bucket_type, coalesce(a.bucket_start, b.bucket_start) as bucket_start, trim_scale(a.qty)::text as from_qty, trim_scale(b.qty)::text as to_qty, a.firm_yn as from_firm, b.firm_yn as to_firm from (select * from sal_forecast_line where rev_id = #{fromRevId}) a full join (select * from sal_forecast_line where rev_id = #{toRevId}) b on b.item_id = a.item_id and b.bucket_type = a.bucket_type and b.bucket_start = a.bucket_start join mst_item i on i.item_id = coalesce(a.item_id, b.item_id) order by i.item_cd, 5, 6
select count(*) from sal_forecast_line
